text:
I highly recommend this dental clinic. The clinic is very clean, modern, and meets high professional standards. The dental chairs and equipment are brand new, which made me feel confident and comfortable throughout the treatment.
The dentist explains everything clearly before and after the procedure, with detailed explanations and photo documentation, which is very reassuring. The prices are reasonable and affordable compared to other clinics, offering great value for the quality of care.
I especially appreciate that the clinic uses modern dental technology to ensure accurate and effective treatment. Overall, an excellent experience — definitely a clinic worth visiting for anyone looking for quality dental care.

restaurant_name: Dental Square Clinic คลินิกทันตกรรมเด็นตัลสแควร์ (สี่แยกเหม่งจ๋าย)
text:
Not a good place for foreigners. They tried to oversell, overcharged, bait and switched, and rushed through the procedure missing critical steps. They couldn't even get their stories aligned when I inquired about the extra charges. Felt like I was dealing with salesmen rather than medical professionals.

One of their dentists left a big hole in my gum that was bleeding for days, from a very shakey injection. When replacing my fillings, he just removed the old fillings and immediately put on the new fillings. I suffered tooth sensitivity for weeks afterwards. So I saw another dentist at another clinic, who found that when these guys had replaced the fillings, they didn't clean out the decay, so (a) the new fillings didn't bond to the teeth properly and (b) it left a high risk of internal decay that could lead to a root canal.

We thought that going to a small local clinic would be safer than going to a big place for tourists. But I was treated very much like an unwitting tourist here. Travellers beware.
